subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using the parts of sentences from each column of the table below:
stimulus: must be chaos and disorder in the society. Discipline is a very important factor in human life. It means not to deny individual freedom. The absence of discipline aims at maintaining social harmony, order and the like. obedience to some sort of rules and regulations.
guide_solution: (a) Discipline means obedience to some sort of rules and regulations. (b) It must be a very important factor in human life. (c) It is not to deny individual freedom. (d) Discipline aims at maintaining social harmony, order and the like. (e) The absence of discipline means chaos and disorder in the society.
